title: Elra Kaaleliyatte Kaala
overview: Elra Kaaleliyatte Kaala follows Vijay, who gets stranded in the unusual village of Idnodu, where life moves without clocks and time feels suspended. As he tries to leave, he is drawn into its rhythm, gradually confronting the tension between urgency and stillness.
